name: sentinel_real_v4_balanced

threshold_selection.score: p_scam = softmax over the first label token for 'scam' / 'promo' / 'legit' after the forced prefix {"label": "
threshold_selection.calibration_set: test_uci_ham_calibration_v1_calibration (2,401 UCI ham, never trained on)
threshold_selection.rule: smallest threshold flagging at most floor(1% x n) calibration messages (tie-aware: just above the (k+1)-th highest score)
threshold_selection.uncertainty: 500 bootstrap resamples of the calibration set -> threshold CI and the induced CIs on every source
threshold_selection.report_also: argmax label decision; full threshold curve 0.05-0.999 per source

notes: Approved 2026-10-04 (docs/SENTINEL_V4_PROPOSAL.md): identical to v3 except training scams = 1,551 (1:1 with legit+promo) and MOZ-Smishing added as an evaluation-only external test (licence accepted by the owner for evaluation only).

scam_cap.strategy: stratified (same sampler as v3): scam_type x language bucket; proportional with floor; round-robin over near-duplicate clusters; rarest lure combination first
scam_cap.floor_note: 29 = round(150 x 1551/8000): v3's floor scaled to the smaller sample (150 x 14 strata would exceed 1,551). Fixed 2026-10-04 before any v4 result.
